list.name: metric_name
list.label: Metric
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_name FROM metrics_raw ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $metric_name
panels.description: Stitched trend across all three retention tiers: metrics_raw (last 7 days, native resolution) -> metrics_1h (7 days-3 months) -> metrics_4h (older than 3 months). Each sub-query only touches its own time slice, so this stays cheap even when zoomed out to months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time AS "time",
  labels->>'instance' AS instance,
  value
FROM metrics_raw
WHERE metric_name = '$metric_name'
  AND time > now() - interval '7 days'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  bucket AS "time",
  labels->>'instance' AS instance,
  avg_value AS value
FROM metrics_1h
WHERE metric_name = '$metric_name'
  AND bucket <= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND bucket > now() - interval '90 days'
  AND $__timeFilter(bucket)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  bucket AS "time",
  labels->>'instance' AS instance,
  avg_value AS value
FROM metrics_4h
WHERE metric_name = '$metric_name'
  AND bucket <= now() - interval '90 days'
  AND $__timeFilter(bucket)

ORDER BY 1
